text:
ravi: Following up on the GPU capacity postmortem — putting a short sprint plan here so we can hand off ownership cleanly. Goal: reduce recurrence risk for bursty traffic patterns and make autoscaler less brittle.

hyun: thanks. high level owners?

ravi: proposed split: quota & cloud ops -> sana, autoscaler + tuning -> hyun, headroom metrics & runbook -> marta, verification + demo -> leia. Ops-bot can create tickets.

sana: Ill reach out to cloud sales tomorrow. I want A100 and B-stage (quantized) fallback SKUs in us-east-1 and us-west-2. ETA: request submitted by Mon EOD, response typically 48-72h. Mark blocked until approval.

marta: monitoring gap: we never had a single-source-of-truth for "effective headroom" across zones. I'll add: per-zone free_gpus gauge, effective_headroom_pct computed from p95 latency sims, and a churn-rate counter.

hyun: tuning notes: current scaler uses fixed headroom pct + immediate scale-up. We should add two changes: 1) smoothing (EWMA) on incoming qps to avoid reacting to 10s blips; 2) elastic preemption buffer to keep a small standby pool that doesn't trigger scale-down immediately. Draft config below.

marta: paste the config?

hyun: sure: 
```
scaler:
  smoothing: ewma
  smoothing_alpha: 0.25
  demand_window_sec: 120
  headroom_strategy: latency_percentile
  target_percentile: 90
  standby_pool:
    size: 2
    eviction_cooldown_sec: 600
  zone_balance: true
```

ravi: standby_pool is interesting. we should cap cost impact: standby_pool.size should be configurable per-customer-tier. Ops-bot create a feature-flag.

ops-bot: Created tasks: #7630 (quota request) -> sana, #7631 (autoscaler tuning) -> hyun, #7632 (headroom metrics & runbook) -> marta, #7633 (verification & demo) -> leia. Feature-flag ticket #7634 created.

leia: for verification I'll build a small harness: replay two spike patterns (many short spikes, and long sustained) and measure p95, pod churn, and failed scheduling events. Acceptance: p95 tail reduced by 20% vs baseline and failed scheduling events = 0 for short bursts. ETA for harness + results: 1 week.

sana: adding blocker label "quota-await" to #7630. If quotas are delayed we fallback to route lower-priority traffic to CPU-quantized models and enable reduced-batch mode.

marta: runbook snippet (short): 1) confirm effective_headroom_pct per zone, 2) if <10%: enable reduced-batch & CPU-fallback, 3) increase standby_pool to 3 if quota available, 4) open emergency quota escalation with cloud-sales. I'll push full runbook to docs repo.

hyun: rollout plan: canary in single AZ with standby_pool=1 for 30m, if churn < 5/min and p95 < threshold then expand to region. Auto-rollback if failed_scheduling_events > 0 for 10m.

leia: adding smoke test checklist to each PR: one-line verify command that runs the harness pattern and checks p95 and scheduling failures.

sana: timeline recap: #7630 submit Mon, #7631 PR draft Thu, #7632 monitoring PR Fri, #7633 harness done in 1 week.

ravi: ops-bot, please create a recurring 20-min standup for the sprint (Mon/Wed/Fri) for 3 weeks and add the tickets to the sprint board.

ops-bot: Recurring standup created Mon/Wed/Fri 09:00 for 3 weeks. Tickets added to sprint board: #7630-#7634. Calendar invites sent.

marta: alerts to add: effective_headroom_pct < 12% for 10m (sev2), pod_churn_rate > 5/min for 5m (sev1), and failed_scheduling_events > 0 (sev1 immediate).

hyun: I'll include config toggles so standby_pool can be zeroed in lower-cost modes. Also adding a sim in the load suite to validate ewma smoothing behavior.

leia: note for demo: I'll capture before/after dashboards and short video of the harness to show to infra leads.

ravi: great. last ask: everyone add a single-sentence verification step in their PRs. we'll reconvene after the first canary completes. closing thread for now.
